convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'Fast2' and two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and smoothing algorithms. Custom indicator with configurable smoothing methods requires manual replication.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timestamping
derived_values.used_by: BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen signal time parameter

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: Opposite MA crossover closes position when BuyPosClose/SellPosClose is enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT means fixed lots at 0.1; MMMode=LOT means MM is lot size directly; other modes (FMM, PMM) interpret MM as percentage/fraction of margin

custom_logic_notes: Signal detected on bar[1] vs bar[0] of indicator buffers (offset by SignalBar=1 from current bar). Entry uses UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime (last bar date + TimeShiftSec) passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen from TradeAlgorithms.mqh which likely uses this for trade validation or pending order placement. The four boolean toggles (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) independently gate each action - the EA can be configured to only close or only open on each side. The Recount flag ensures indicator data is re-fetched on failure. Signal bar is configurable (SignalBar=1 means signal from 1 bar back).
python_conversion_notes: Two external libraries must be replicated: (1) SmoothAlgorithms.mqh provides 10 smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) - need Python implementations for each, especially the non-standard ones (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). (2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar - must replicate position management, new-bar detection, and lot sizing logic. The custom 'Fast2' indicator is a dual MA crossover that must be reimplemented as two smoothed MAs. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) - need to confirm if these are already point-adjusted or need 5-digit correction. Signal bar offset of 1 means signals are from the previous completed bar, which is standard for backtesting. The MM input with MMMode enum supports multiple sizing modes that must be handled.
